improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating the product value and free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, consistent previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the starting price and free searches removes friction by setting expectations upfront.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI-Powered Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support for your business operations. Try three free searches — no credit card required."
improvements.rationale: This headline immediately establishes what Gideon is (AI assistant) and who it serves (trade and business professionals). The subheading reinforces the three core value props (instant answers, voice chat, professional support) while creating a low-friction entry point by highlighting the free trial without payment commitment. The structure follows proven SaaS conversion patterns: clear product identity + key benefits + risk-free call to action.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to become a member. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, giving you unlimited access to Gideon's AI-powered trade and business support, voice chat, and your own members workspace. Choose annual billing to save 30 percent.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most common friction point in a freemium model—what happens when the free trial ends. It reassures prospects there's no surprise, clearly states the low entry price, highlights key benefits, and nudges toward annual billing for savings. This reduces abandonment at the paywall and builds trust.
